Commentary.Commentary: Seems like we have time for a couple of overs before the interval. Stay tuned...

Kagiso Rabada was the pick of the bowlers tonight. His terrific yorker to Guptill set things up early on and then he came back to dismiss Neesham and later de Grandhomme. All the bowlers bowled well but special mention must go to Imran Tahir for his phenomenal spell of 10-0-14-2 - his most economical one in ODIs.

Williamson's dismissal saw the Kiwis fall from 42/1 to 87/6, from where they could not recover. There was a brief resistance when Santner and de Grandhomme added 45 for the 7th wicket but it was not enough.

So 150 is all the Proteas need to win the series here in Auckland. A feeble batting display from the home side, with only Colin de Grandhomme managing to cross 30. They lacked partnerships, getting 25 for the second wicket between Brownlie and Williamson before a collapse set them back.

OUT! Excellent review this! Rabada thinks he's got his man and wants a review. QDK too is assured that Colin has nicked it and AB reviews it! Coming back to the delivery, it was a back of a length ball, around off, Colin looks to whack it away over mid-wicket but only manages to get a faint edge to QDK. The snicko shows that there was an edge and the Kiwis are all out for 149!
South Africa review for a caught behind of Colin de Grandhomme!
Kagiso Rabada is back into the attack!
Boult eases this tossed up delivery towards mid on. A magnificent spell from Tahir comes to an end. His figures - 10-0-14-2.
Boult tries to be cheeky and tries to play the reverse sweep however he doesn't connect. Tahir appeals half heatedly but the umpire is not interested!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Lures Boult to come forward and he does. He looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and falls just short of the first slip.
Bowls this on the sticks, Boult blocks it.

What has Andile done here? He's been completely misjudged a catch. Tosses this one outside off, Colin dances down the track and whacks it over covers. It seemed like he will have to depart but Phehlukwayo fails to see the ball and it bounces in front of him. Tahir is upset. They run a single.
PowerPlay 3 has been signalled! 5 fielders allowed outside the circle now.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
A terrific yorker on middle, Boult dances and somehow manages to block it out.
Ooooo.... Boult backs away, exposing all his sticks and Morris bowls a slower delivery, right at the base of the stumps. But Boult blocks it out.

Landed outside off, Colin dabs it to the off side and sets off for a single via habit. Then he stops, realizing that there is only one wicket left. He is in two minds whether to take the single or not and eventually takes it.
Banged in short, pulled straight to short mid-wicket.
Full on middle, de Grandhomme pushes this towards mid on.
Full and well outside off, Boult gets well across and lets it go. Gets the loudest cheers from the crowd.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
TRENT BOULT is the last man in. A leg slip and silly mid off has been deployed.

OUT! LBW! The googly does the trick. Patel stays back to work it to the leg side but the ball straightens, goes past his bat and hits him on the pads. Tahir appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Was the impact outside off? Will have to wait to see the replays. Patel has a chat with de Grandhomme about the review but the latter sends him back. Hawk Eye shows the IMPACT OUTSIDE OFF. Missing off too. Tough luck.
Mid on drops down to long on for Patel. A nice in-out field.
Landed outside off, de Grandhomme looks to defend from the crease but gets a thick inside edge. A single taken.
A bouncer to end the over, JP ducks.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR LEG BYES! A short ball down the leg side, Patel looks to flick but the ball goes off his thighs past the diving keeper to the fine leg fence.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a quick single.
Stays back and defends.
A short ball outside off, de Grandhomme goes for the pull but misses.
CHRIS MORRIS is back on.
Oopps...Patel gets across and tries to flick it away, almost ends up giving a catch to the diving leg slip. Lands just short of Faf du Plessis.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
JEETAN PATEL comes in at number 9, replacing Southee.

OUT! Caught and bowled! This was coming. Full and outside off, Southee looks to sweep it away but ends up fetching for it. Gets a top edge which goes straight up in the air. Tahir jogs back and takes a dolly. Simple catch.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
IMRAN TAHIR is back on.
SIX! Lovely shot! Fractionally short on middle, Southee pulls this comfortably over mid-wicket. There is a man at the ropes but it sails over!
Goes for the cut again, gets another bottom edge.
Landed outside off, Tim looks to cut but gets a bottom edge.
The batsman gets a bottom edge of the bat on that one.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Full and outside off, de Grandhomme drives it to deepish mid off for a quick single. AB de Villiers has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Could have been close had he hit.
Tim Southee walks out to bat!

OUT! Wonderful piece of fielding! On a length around off, Santner tries to steer it down past point, but fails and sets off. As Duminy dives to his left, makes a sharp save and direct hits at the striker's end. Santner is way out of his crease and the South Africans are delighted! The single was not there and a promising partnership has been broken due to some athletic fielding from JP!
Length delivery around off, Santner goes back and punches it towards mid on.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Length ball, around off, Santner pushes it towards covers. They look for a single but the cover fielder doesn't allow them to run through.

FOUR! Brilliant batting this from Mitchell, he's putting all the bad balls away. Shortish delivery, around leg, he camps back and pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary. More of those, Williamson must be praying!
Back of a length delivery, around middle and leg, Colin pull is towards backward square leg for a single.
DRINKS BREAK.
A short ball down the leg side, pulled towards fine leg for one.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.

SIX! CLUNK! New Zealand need more of that. A length ball outside off, de Grandhomme comes down the track and slaps it over AB de Villiers at mid off. Manages to clear the ropes as well. De Grandhomme moves to 22 from 32 balls.
Outside off, Colin looks to force it through the off side but gets a bottom edge towards cover.
A bouncer but down the leg side, de Grandhomme ducks.
Outside off, played straight to point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A length ball on middle, Santner heaves it through mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Landed outside off, Santner decides to play at that as an afterthought and gets a bottom edge which gets the ball to go over the stumps.
Full and straight, de Grandhomme looks to flick across the line but misses. Luckily for him, the ball takes the inside edge and hits him on his pads. The batsmen steal a quick single.
DWAINE PRETORIUS is back on.
A driveable ball outside off, MS looks to drive but misses.
Phehlukwayo holds the length back a touch, gives Santner no room to free his arms and Mitchell defends.

FOUR! Neatly done. Just the second boundary for Santner. A length ball on middle and leg, Santner whips it over mid-wicket. The timing is not the greatest but with an unmanned boundary, it turns out to be enough.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.
On a good length around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full on middle, driven down to long on for a single.
ANDILE PHEHLUKWAYO is back on.
Comes down the track and pushes it down for one more.
Excellent piece of fielding. Full on middle, Santner pushes this down the ground, over the bowler. The ball races to the fence but Kagiso Rabada races to his right to stop the ball. Just a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, driven through mid on for a single.
Goes back and punches it towards mid on.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery, Santner punches it towards mid-wicket who fails to stop it. They ponder over a single but avoid the risk.
On a length around middle, Santner stands firm and blocks it with the straight face of the bat!
Fullish delivery fourth stump line, buries it from well within the crease.
Length ball, on the pads, Santner stays in his crease and defends it towards the leg side.
Full delivery on the sticks, Colin gets across and knocks it through mid on. One run added to the total!
Length ball around off, Santner drives it off the back foot and runs one.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Santner eases this tossed up delivery through mid off for a single.

Floated delivery around middle and leg, Santner dances down the track and hits it. But the ball crashes onto the non striker's end and goes towards long off fielder. It seemed like Santner was in trouble but a wayward throw from the long off fielder ensures he gets back in his crease in time.
Loops this one around off, Santner taps it towards point.
Quicker and flatter on the stumps, Santner goes back and drives it towards covers.
Tosses this one around off, Santner leans forward to block.
Santner knocks this length delivery to long off for a single.

Lands this on a length around middle, Colin works it around to David Miller at mid-wicket who makes a good save. However, his throw at the striker's end doesn't connect. Had it been a direct hit, Santner would've been out! One run added to the total!
Full delivery around off, de Grandhomme strides forward to defend.
On a length around off, Colin gets across and whips it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball, around off, Colin drives it towards covers.
Fullish delivery, around off, Santner pushes it towards covers and sets off. The cover fielder is a bit sloppy and they run through for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Bowls this one around off, Santner cuts it towards point for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Santner looks to dab it to third man but edges it. However the ball falls short of the slip fielder.
DROPPED! Looks to offer flight, ends up bowling a low full toss. Santner drives it back to Tahir who fails to grab onto it. South Africa have dropped two catches!
Looped up delivery, Colin knocks it to long on for a single. 100 run comes up for New Zealand with that shot!
Tosses this around off, Colin drives it towards covers.
Imran Tahir is back on.
Marginally ahead of length, outside off, Santner watches it go to the keeper.
Bowls a length delivery around off, Santner looks to steer it down to third man and gets beaten.
Short of a length ball, angling in, Colin swivels and pulls it through fine leg for a single.
Lands a length ball around off, Colin connects his drive perfectly albeit to the mid off fielder.
Short of a length ball, outside off, CDG cuts it towards covers.
On a length ball, around off, de Grandhomme knocks it towards the bowler.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Bowls this down the leg side, CDG tickles it off the toe end of the bat for a boundary. Poor delivery that and gets duly punished.

DROPPED! Rabada spills one in his followthrough. Straighter length delivery, de Grandhomme looks to chip it over the bowler but mistimes it. Rabada gets his right hand to it but fluffs it in the end. A reprieve for the batsman, Rabada was too fast in his followthrough and failed to judge the pace of the ball that was coming to him.
Rabada bangs this short, CDG ducks under it and allows QDK to collect it.
Length ball outside off, Colin lets it through to QDK.
Back of a length delivery, around off, CDG goes back and pushes it towards mid on.
Angles this on middle, de Grandhomme flicks it past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Length ball, around middle and leg, CDG is rock solid in defense.
Fullish delivery around off, tries to go over mid on. But it takes the outside edge and goes over the slip cordon towards third man. They run a single.
Lands this on a length, on the sticks, Santner strides forward and pushes it towards covers.
On a length around off, Santner knocks it towards mid off.
Length ball, angling in, Colin stays in his crease and whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, around off, Santner chips it handsomely over covers for a couple.
Bowls a yorker length ball, Santner does well to jam it away.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Colin de Grandhomme is the next man in.

OUT! What a review. On the first instance, it seemed like it is India who took the review and not South Africa given that they have a knack of wasting the reviews. It looked like that it came off his helmet. But replays show it didn't. Back of a length delivery, angling in, Neesham looks to pull it away but is no position to do it whatsoever. It kisses the bat, hits the helmet and lobs towards point as Duminy collects it easily. South Africans appeal but the umpire is unmoved. The South Africans review it successfully. The misery continues for the hosts. They are six down!
South Africa take a review as Neesham is caught at point.
Back of a length delivery, makes Neesham go back in is crease and he does. The ball stays surprisingly low but Neesham keeps it away.
Bowls a fuller delivery on off, Neesham stays in his crease and drives it to mid off.
Kagiso Rabada is back into the attack!
Back of a length delivery around off, Santner looks to dab it away but doesn't quite connect as the ball rolls to the point fielder.
Bowls this around off, Santner knocks this to mid off.
FOUR! In the air...... and safe. On a length outside off, Santner drives it uppishly towards covers, but it goes past covers for a boundary. Finally gets off the mark.
Lands in another length ball, fifth stump line, shoulders his arms.
On a length ball, outside off, Santner watchfully lets it through to de Kock.
WIDE! Morris bangs this short and well over Santner as QDK collects it sharply. The umpire signals a wide!
Play and a miss! Morris steams in and bowls a length ball outside off, Santner looks to drive but the ball whistles past his willow.
On a length on the sticks, Neesham drives it back to the bowler.
Neesham knocks this length delivery towards point.

SIX! Outstanding timing! Full delivery around off, Neesham waits for it and sends it soaring high over long off for a maximum. Holds his pose for the photographers. Vital runs these from Neesham for New Zealand.
Lands a length ball around off, Neesham looks to steer it down to third man but the ball falls back onto the pitch.
Length delivery outside off, Neesham's cut goes straight to point.

FOUR! Neesham is in destruction mode, he's scoring only in boundaries. Short delivery around off, Neesham goes back a bit and whacks it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary. The deep square leg fielder had no chance!
Full and straight, watchfully kept out.
On a good length around off, watchfully kept out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, angling away, Santner pushes at it, then decides to take his bat away. Is late and gets beaten.
MITCHELL SANTNER walks in at number 7, replacing Ronchi.

OUT! Gloved behind! The Black Caps have now lost half their side as Morris gets amongst the wickets as well. A short ball outside off, Ronchi perhaps initially thinks of ramping it over the keeper. Then maybe he thinks better of it. Tries to sway away. But while doing so, the ball just brushes his gloves enroute to de Kock. The Proteas erupt in an appeal and the umpire raises his finger. A promising stand is broken.

FOUR! HANDSOME! A flurry of runs for the Kiwis, that too, in boundaries! Full and straight, Ronchi drives it straight back to where it came from. Farhaan Behardien dives to his left from mid on but in vain.
CHRIS MORRIS is back on.
FOUR! Three boundaries in the last 6 balls for Jimmy. Full and straight, he just flicks it through mid-wicket. Finds the gap and then the boundary.
Comes a bit forward and works it to the leg side.
Stays right back in his crease this time and blocks.
Full and straight, driven back to the bowler.

FOUR! GLORIOUS! Back-to-back boundaries for Neesham. Gets a low full toss around off, he comes forward and drives this straight back past the bowler. Into the fence goes the ball. The stand moves to 13 from 14 balls. Neesham is now on 10 from 11 deliveries.
Back of a length around off, pulled through square leg for a single.
Dwaine Pretorius is brought into the attack.
FOUR! GORGEOUS! Full and outside off, Neesham breaks the shackles a bit and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
Stays right back in his crease and blocks.
Risky shot again. Full and straight, Neesham swings hard and gets it off the inner half of the bat through square leg. Gets a couple.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Outside off, watchfully kept out.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, dabbed straight to short third man.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
JIMMY NEESHAM walks in at number 6, replacing Taylor.

OUT! LBW! Oh dear... this is T-R-O-U-B-L-E for the Kiwis. On a length outside off, nipping back in, Taylor makes the big mistake of playing across the line. Now, when you take that risk, you should not miss the ball. Else you can be a dead duck. That is exactly what happened to Brownlie. That has exactly what has happened to Taylor. Plumb LBW. The Kiwis are throwing it away here. 3 wickets for 9 runs in the last 5.1 overs. Phehlukwayo has his second.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a run to finally get off the mark.
LBW appeal, but turned down. Ronchi has a heave-ho across the line but misses. That was going over the top, one guesses.
Down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for a quick single.
On a good length outside off, Taylor looks to punch but mistimes it towards cover.
Around off, pushed straight to cover. Cannot get Tahir away, can Ronchi?
Short and outside off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
Comes down the track and pushes it towards mid on for a quick single. Good batting, New Zealand don't want to be stifled here. Need to rotate the strike often.
Around middle and leg, blocked to the leg side.
Tossed up outside leg, watchfully defended.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads. A strong appeal from the bowler and fielders. The Umpire shows no interest in the appeal.
Outside off, pushed to the off side.
The batsman has played it fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done. On a length outside off, Taylor punches this down the ground and gets a boundary!
Outside off, Taylor looks to drive but is beaten.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Nagging line, pushed back to the bowler. Just outside off is Tahir.
Beautiful line, just around off, well kept out.
Tossed up around off, defended back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Full and down the leg side, Taylor misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards short fine leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. A WICKET MAIDEN FOR PHEHLUKWAYO!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, watchfully blocked out.
LUKE RONCHI walks in at number 5, replacing Brownlie.

OUT! LBW! That is so, so plumb. On a length outside off, Brownlie looked to manufacture a whip through mid-wicket but then that manufacturing needed some connection. The willow came down late and missed the ball and it made contact with the pads. Phehlukwayo appealed, the umpire took his time and eventually raised his finger! Brownlie had a long chat with Taylor but was sent on his way back. Hawk Eye showed it to be missing off. Missing leg. Hitting middle. Bang!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Landed outside off, defended watchfully.
Double change. ANDILE PHEHLUKWAYO comes on to bowl as well.
ROSS TAYLOR walks in at number 4, replacing his skipper.

OUT! Williamson is gone. Big trouble. Communication failure. Around off, Brownlie worked it through mid-wicket. He set off for the single and Williamson responded but then AB de Villiers at short mid-wicket threw himself to his right and stopped the ball. Now, Brownlie stuttered and so did Williamson. De Villiers was quick to pick up and throw the ball to de Kock who disturbed the bails. Williamson's bat got stuck outside the crease and the Proteas started celebrating. It was referred upstairs and sure enough, Williamson was nowhere in the frame. Massive blow.
Run out appeal! Williamson looks to be gone here! He is walking, but still it is referred upstairs...
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
A floater on off, Dean looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
A touch shorter around off, Brownlie goes back and punches it towards long on but short mid-wicket intercepts.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended.
As soon as the fielding restrictions are lifted, on comes IMRAN TAHIR.
POWERPLAY 2 has been signalled. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Shortish delivery, Brownlie pulls it over square leg, didn't connect as he would've liked to and gets two runs for it!
Another good shot for no run! Length ball around off, Brownlie cuts it on the up towards covers.

FOUR! Lovely shot from Brownlie. Executes the pull extremely well. Short of a length delivery, DB rocks back and pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary. That will give him immense confidence.
Quality cricket all around! Length ball, on the sticks, DB flicks it towards backward square leg as the fielder there makes a good stop. Think it was Andile!
Length ball outside off, Williamson dabs it towards third man for a single.

In the air.... lands safe! Back of a length delivery, around off, DB tries to pull it over mid-wicket but it takes the leading edge and lobs towards mid on. However the ball falls way ahead of the fielder at mid on. They run a single.
Attempted yorker! Bowls a full delivery, but on the pads, Williamson jams it towards backward square leg for no run.
Fullish delivery, fourth stump line, Williamson stays in his crease and drives it to mid on.
Good length delivery outside off, Kane cuts it to the point fielder.

Good running! Length ball around  off, DB pushes it to covers and sets off immediately. AB at covers throws it at the striker's end but misses! However, Williamson would have made his ground even if he hit it.
Rabada hits the deck hard, Brownlie picks it up early and lets it go through as he ducks under it.
Full delivery on the sticks, DB drives it to the mid on fielder.
Marginally ahead of length on the pads, Brownlie works it away through long leg and runs a single.
Good length delivery on the sticks, Brownlie times his straight drive beautifully, but straight to the mid on fielder.
Lands a length ball which comes back in, Brownlie drives it back to Morris who collects it in his followthrough.
Angles in a length delivery on the pads, Brownlie flicks it away towards the square leg fielder.
On a length around off, Brownlie blocks it towards covers.
Leg bye! Length ball, swinging in, Williamson looks to tickle it away but it goes off his pads towards fine leg. One run added to the total!
Length ball, around off, Brownlie defends it from his crease.
WIDE! Bowls another delivery towards the leg side. The umpire calls it a wide!

Length ball, outside off, Dean drives it towards Rabada. The bowler looks to have a shy at the striker's end after seeing that the batsman was slightly out of his crease. But the ball hits the batsman on the pads. Rabada asks Brownlie whether he's okay, he responds with a thumbs up.
Marginally ahead of a length, on middle, Brownlie drives it towards mid on.
FOUR! Brilliant placement. On a length around off, Brownlie backs away a bit and just guides it past the point fielder. The third man fielder gives it a chase but it is too fast for him!
Length ball, angles it in, Brownlie is cramped for room but cuts it towards covers.
Brilliant fielding! Bowls this outside off, DB cuts it but Miller at cover-point runs to his left and makes a one hand save.
Wide. Sprays this down the leg side, Brownlie looks to tickle it away but the ball was too away from him. The umpire signals a wide!
Length ball, on the sticks, Williamson flicks it towards mid-wicket.
On a length, swinging in, Kane drives, as the bat twists in his hand, towards the leg side.
Length ball, angling in, Williamson's flick goes between the square leg and mid-wicket fielders. They run a couple.
Fullish delivery, on the middle, Williamson offers a front foot defense.
Bowls a length delivery around off, Williamson knocks it back to the bowler.
Length delivery around middle, Kane flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery, around middle, Williamson nudges this behind square for a single.
FOUR! Wow. Bowls another yorker, Williamson's dig goes towards third man for a boundary. It was a delivery that deserved a wicket but it wasn't meant to be. Rabada is looking in good rhythm.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Kane Williamson is the new man in.

OUT! Cleaned him up! Beautiful yorker! Guptill backs away a tad bit looking to hit it over covers, however the pace was too much for him and misses it. The ball takes the bails off and the batsman has to depart. The danger man who scored 180 has to make way for his captain.
Bangs this short, Guptill does well to leave it alone!
Length ball around middle, DB flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length delivery, around off, DB pulls it to long leg for a single.
Two wides! Bouncer! Guptill ducks and QDK fails to collect it. They run for a single.

What has happened here? Length delivery, around leg, Guptill dances down the track looking to whack it away over mid-wicket. But misses, however there is a noise as the ball goes past him and QDK is excited. He thinks its out and wants a review. But AB thinks otherwise and wants the keeper to approach him before thinking about a review. The noise was the ball hitting his shirt.
OUCH! That must have hurt. Angles in this length delivery and Guptill gets struck on the pad.
Length ball, on the stumps, Guptill drives this towards mid on.

FOUR! Not an Ideal way for Guptill to get off the mark. Bowls a length delivery, around off, Guptill lofts it over extra covers but didn't quite go where he would have wanted to as the ball goes through the point over covers. But he will not complain. Gets a boundary!
Good length delivery around off, Guptill defends it from well within his crease.
Back of a length delivery, Brownlie stands firm in his crease and blocks it.
On a length outside off, DB cuts it towards point.
Good length delivery, around middle, Brownlie flicks it towards fine leg for a brace.
A similar delivery same result. The South Africans have managed to beat the Kiwis on the outside edge for a few times now. Length delivery, DB is in his crease and gets beaten.
Short of a length delivery, the ball whistles past DB's bat!
Length delivery outside off, Brownlie cuts it through point and runs two. The point fielder gives it a good chase to stop it.
Lands this on a length, on the sticks, Guptill drives this uppishly towards Pretorius at mid on who dives forward to catch it but the ball falls short of him.
Good length delivery, swinging in, Guptill's front foot defense takes the inside edge and goes onto hit his pad.
Back of a length delivery, fourth stump line, Guptill stands in his crease to defend but the ball whizzes past his willow.
On a length, around the pads, Dean works it through fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Punished! Good length delivery, angling down the leg side and all DB has to do is to tickle it away and he does. Gets a boundary in reward. First runs on the board for the home side.
On a length delivery, swinging back in, Brownlie moves across a bit and flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Chris Morris to bowl from the other end.
Ends the over with a bouncer. Guptill ducks to leave it alone. Good start for the visitors. Maiden over!
On a length on the stumps, Guptill knocks this to the mid on fielder.
Length delivery, around off, Guptill tries to defend bit but gets beaten because of the bounce. Lovely bowling from the South African.
Good shape from Rabada there. Lands this on a length, angling in, Guptill stands firm in his crease and blocks it.
Bowls a length delivery outside off, Guptill has no reason to play at it.
Rabada starts his spell with a length ball outside off, Guptill defends it towards point.

Right then, the South Africans are taking their positions in the field. Martin Guptill and Dean Brownlie have arrived at the crease. AB de Villiers tosses the ball to Kagiso Rababda and he will kick off things for South Africa.
Team news - The hosts have named an unchanged XI. While, the visitors as expected have brought in Andile Phelukwayo for Wayne Parnell.
TOSS - South Africa have whitewashed New Zealand as far as the toss is concerned. They have won it again and opted to field first.

Hello and welcome to the fifth and the final ODI of this series. New Zealand and South Africa, Eden Park. We have all seen this before. While this match might not hold as much importance as a World Cup semifinal. But it is still a match (series decider) that has context and neither side would like to lose it. Martin Guptill slammed 180 to help level Kiwis the series in Hamilton. And now when both these teams lock horns in Auckland, both have their own objectives or incentives, as you would like to call it.
